dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a new book to read, but I'm on a tight budget. Could you tell me what books you have available that cost $15 or less?
dialogue.agent:
Great news! We have plenty of books under $15. Here are some of the top-rated options:

1. **"Hit The Road!: A Badass Mom's Guide For Families who Want to Travel the World"** — $12.99, ⭐ 5.0 (3 reviews)
2. **"Ignition: A Professional Woman's Guide to Energized, Burnout-Proof Living"** — $14.99, ⭐ 5.0 (2 reviews)
3. **"Musings & Vignettes: A sketchbook for thoughts and illustrations"** — $5.00, ⭐ 5.0 (3 reviews)
4. **"The Blackwater Chronicle: A Narrative of an Expedition into the Land of Canaan in Randolph County, Virginia"** — $14.95, ⭐ 5.0 (1 review)
5. **"Thoughts on Small Boat Racing"** — $8.98, ⭐ 5.0 (1 review)
6. **"From Apathy to Harmony: A Collection of Poems"** — $5.50, ⭐ 5.0 (1 review)

What kind of genre or topic are you interested in? Fiction, non-fiction, self-help, travel, poetry, or something else? That way I can narrow it down to something perfect for you!

products.description: About the Author Chris Vasiliadis, a National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach, inspires people to use their well-being as their secret weapon to successfully lead their life. Working both one-on-one and speaking in professional, healthcare and corporate settings since founding her business, Priority Wellness (www.prioritywellness.com), in 2008, she has helped countless individuals energize their health, avoid burnout and improve their performance. A lover of reading and writing since childhood, Ignition is her first book.

Crustaceans (Copyright 2003 by Chucklebooks Publishing, Inc.) Crustaceans are an interesting breed; Some people think theyre swell fish. But dont believe in everything you read  I find them rather shellfish. (selfish) ---------------------------------------- Duck! (Copyright 2003 by Chucklebooks Publishing, Inc.) Theyve been quacking so much about Mabels big flight  How she soared like a jet in the stadiums light, How she heard all the cheers as she tilted her wings And then twisted and curved out those spirally things. She would weave in and out as she spun all her spins, Neatly outing her outs and then inning her ins. She was painting the sky with her brush widely spread, Till that baseball flew into the side of her head. Quickly plummeting down, Mabels fate appeared sealed, And they all feared the worst as she lay in right field. But Im pleased to report that I did make it through, And despite all the talk I have this to tell you: Theyve been quacking and honking all day about me, But the day wasnt all it was quacked up to be. (cracked) ---------------------------------------- A Clothes-minded Vacuum (Closed-minded) (Copyright 2003 by Chucklebooks Publishing, Inc.) My mom has chores that she assigns. I do them perfectly. But I have found that vacuuming is not a chore for me. I used to do it all the time, until that fateful day The vacuum cleaner acted in a most unfriendly way. For, as I ran the vacuum, cleaning all the dust and dirt, The hose I held escaped me and it turned and got my shirt. The vacuum sucked the shirt down then it took my new watch, too. And, next, it seemed quite focused on the thought of my left shoe. Before I had the chance to run, my precious shoe was gone. And then the vacuum snuck up on the shoe I still had on. To save my things from leaving me, I had to jump and dance. But, soon, the hose  it tricked me and it pulled away my pants. Now stranded in my underwear, I started fighting back  I couldnt be left naked from this horrible attack. I wrestled firmly with the hose and got it to the ground. I clenched my teeth and grunted as I got it turned around. What happened next was definitely something very weird: The vacuum swallowed up itself and simply disappeared.

dialogue.user:
Thanks for the list! I'm not really sure what genre I'm into—I'm open to exploring different topics. These all have great ratings, which is exactly what I'm looking for. 

Could you tell me a bit more about **"Ignition: A Professional Woman's Guide to Energized, Burnout-Proof Living"**? Like what's it about and what do the reviews say?
dialogue.agent:
Here's what I found:

**"Ignition: A Professional Woman's Guide to Energized, Burnout-Proof Living"** — $14.99, ⭐ 5.0 (2 reviews)

**About the book:** Written by Chris Vasiliadis, a National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach, this is a practical self-help guide for professional women looking to avoid burnout and boost their energy. It's divided into three parts — establishing foundational habits, exploring essential wellness elements, and creating a personalized 90-day action plan. The author herself has multiple sclerosis and has been relapse-free for over 12 years, so she speaks from real experience!

**What reviewers are saying:**
- ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ *"A must read for all women to keep their self care in check... The stories are so inspiring and the tips and strategies are practical and super helpful."*
- ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ *"This book has truly helped this business owner to re-evaluate how I balance my business and all the stresses... a helpful guide!"*

It's the highest-rated book in your price range with a perfect score! Would you like to know more about any of the other options, or does this one sound like a good fit for you?

result.title: Ignition: A Professional Woman's Guide to Energized, Burnout-Proof Living
result.features: Is chronic "busy-ness" running you into the ground? Instead of constant doing, start being in more engaged, healthy ways. Release society's busy badge of honor and get ready to love the ripple effects of consistent steady energy!Committed to thrive with multiple sclerosis and galvanized by the professional women she's met and coached, health coach Chris Vasiliadis has created a unique guide for customizing your path to ignite your energy and avoid burnout. With a supportive, compassionate tone, Chris ushers you through behavior patterns that work for and against you, in fueling yourself to perform at your best.In Ignition's three parts, using exercises, questions, tips and women's stories, you will establish foundational aspects to bring on your burnout-proofing trek; explore, play with and enhance your chosen essential elements to reveal your capacity, beyond work-life balance, to elevate how you're doing and being in all parts of your life; create your tailor-made ninety-day action plan, including interim milestones, to move toward your specific Wellness Vision of energized, burnout-proof living. Each woman's passage through Ignition will be different. What will you discover as you blaze your new energizing trail?
result.description: About the Author Chris Vasiliadis, a National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach, inspires people to use their well-being as their secret weapon to successfully lead their life. Working both one-on-one and speaking in professional, healthcare and corporate settings since founding her business, Priority Wellness (www.prioritywellness.com), in 2008, she has helped countless individuals energize their health, avoid burnout and improve their performance. Choosing to prioritize her wellness after her multiple sclerosis diagnosis in 2005, Chris has been relapse-free for over 12 years. A lover of reading and writing since childhood, Ignition is her first book.

top_reviews.title: A must read for all women to keep their self care in check.
top_reviews.text: Although I read the book in a linear fashion, you can choose to read the sections that you feel are most relevant to your areas of need. The stories are so inspiring and the tips and strategies are practical and super helpful. This would make a great graduation gift or gift to yourself!

top_reviews.title: For everyone woman who wants to live a balanced life - a must read!!
top_reviews.text: This book has truly helped this business owner to re-evaluate how i balance my business and all the stresses that come with it, and my personal life. It is never an easy task but Christine’s book is such a helpful guide!
